task: Enable the kube-apiserver EventRateLimit admission plugin (CIS 1.2.10 / Trivy AVD-KCV-0010) for fresh installs, joins and existing clusters; keep KCV0001/KCV0012 accepted with corrected reasons.

events.summary: Not verified: HA/Kakao join path and a fresh install on a live cluster; live checks are single-node only (e5).

provenance: agy gemini-4-neon-high research lane: kubernetes v1.35.7 pkg/kubeapiserver/options/plugins.go, plugin/pkg/admission/eventratelimit, aquasecurity/trivy-checks apiserver_*.rego, pkg/kubeapiserver/options/authentication.go, RKE2 and GKE CIS guides
events.summary: EventRateLimit is still registered in v1.35.7 (alpha config v1alpha1) and fails apiserver start on a missing or invalid config; Trivy KCV0001 matches the literal --anonymous-auth=false and --authentication-config cannot be combined with --oidc-* flags; AlwaysPullImages makes the in-cluster registry a start dependency.
Before the change the live apiserver ran --enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction and Trivy reported AVD-KCV-0010 failing on kube-system/Pod/kube-apiserver-narwhal-master-1.
evidence: test:scripts/ops/apply-apiserver-admission.sh dry-run against narwhal-master-1 -> diff only --enable-admission-plugins, --admission-control-config-file and the admission volume/volumeMount; kubeadm-config diff the same

events.summary: 02-init-cluster.sh writes /etc/kubernetes/admission/admission-config.yaml (Server 500/1000, Namespace 50/100 cache 2000; D-ERL) and sets NodeRestriction,EventRateLimit + admission-control-config-file + read-only volume; joins fetch the file (Vagrant and Kakao); scripts/ops/apply-apiserver-admission.sh rolls existing clusters node by node with backups outside the manifests dir, rollback on timeout and a resourceVersion-guarded kubeadm-config patch; R422 added; KCV0012 reason text corrected (no longer says NodeRestriction is the only plugin); kubelet-authz-baseline mutation updated to the new plugin value.

evidence: test:apply rc=0 -> healthy narwhal-master-1, kubeadm-config: patched ClusterConfiguration; new apiserver pod Ready with both flags and the admission mount

test:second --apply on the already-applied node (D-ERL-CFG review fix) -> healthy narwhal-master-1 backup=none, kubeadm-config: already up to date, apiserver pod uid unchanged
